blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecution panel is seeking to introduce as evidence the prior recorded statements of five unnamed witnesses, who could allegedly shed light on former President Rodrigo Duterte’s “kill list” and an alleged rewards system for police officers involved in the war against illegal drugs. The prosecutors made the request in their latest filing dated Oct. 12 made public early Saturday. They asked the Trial Chamber (TC) III to admit the testimonies of witnesses identified only as P-1087, P-1151, P-1158, P-1161 and P-1204 into evidence.
